rituals.title: Intention Setting
rituals.opening: The dark moon is the empty page. Nothing is required of you yet.
steps: Sit somewhere you will not be interrupted for ten minutes.
Write down one thing you want, in the present tense, as though it is already true.
Underneath it, write the smallest action that would make it slightly more true.
Do that action within 48 hours. That is the whole ritual.

rituals.title: Release
rituals.opening: Everything is lit, including what you would rather not look at.
steps: Name one thing you are ready to stop carrying.
Write it down in full. Do not abbreviate it to be polite.
Read it aloud once, to yourself.
Tear the page. Keeping it is also allowed — the point is the naming.

rituals.title: Meeting Resistance
rituals.opening: The half-lit moon is where the friction shows up.
steps: Name what has become harder than you expected.
Ask whether it is difficult or simply unfamiliar.
Choose one thing to make 10% easier, and change it today.

rituals.title: Honest Review
rituals.opening: Before the dark, an accounting. No punishment involved.
steps: List three things that happened this cycle. Any three.
Forgive yourself one specific thing, by name.
